proposal.summary: Eclipse Mosquitto 1.3.2 through 2.x before 2.0.16 has a remote memory leak when a client sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs and does not respond to PUBREC, due to mishandling of EAGAIN from the libc send function.
proposal.cwe_quote: This occurs because of mishandling of EAGAIN from the libc send function.

AV.quote: can be abused remotely when a client sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs, and fails to respond to PUBREC commands.

PR.quote: can be abused remotely when a client sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs, and fails to respond to PUBREC commands.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Reproduce the issue against an affected Mosquitto build to confirm resource consumption and determine whether exploitation can cause process termination or remote code execution; review the send()/EAGAIN handling and patch to avoid leaking allocations on temporary send failures.

evidence_quotes.quote: The broker in Eclipse Mosquitto 1.3.2 through 2.x before 2.0.16 has a memory leak
can be abused remotely when a client sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs, and fails to respond to PUBREC commands.
This occurs because of mishandling of EAGAIN from the libc send function.
